heading.title: Of Offences Relating to Coin, Currency-Notes, Bank-Notes, and Government Stamps

article.title: Using Government stamp known to have been before used
article.content: Whoever, fraudulently or with intent to cause loss to the Government, uses for any purpose a stamp issued by Government for the purpose of revenue, which he knows to have been before used, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
article.html:
184Using Government stamp known to have been before used

Section 184 · Chapter X

Whoever, fraudulently or with intent to cause loss to the Government, uses for any purpose a stamp issued by Government for the purpose of revenue, which he knows to have been before used, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
